content: Each vial of Cefrom 0.25 g contains 0.359 g of powder, which includes 0.298 g of cefpirome sulfate as the active ingredient. This amount corresponds to 0.25 g of cefpirome. Each vial of Cefrom 0.5 g contains 0.717 g of powder, which includes 0.596 g of cefpirome sulfate as the active ingredient. This amount corresponds to 0.5 g of cefpirome. Each vial of Cefrom 1.0 g contains 1.433 g of powder, which includes 1.191 g of cefpirome sulfate as the active ingredient. This amount corresponds to 1.0 g of cefpirome. Sodium carbonate is included as an excipient.
